anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

apparatus: Mostly unrestored or heavily restored Greek; English does not fill gaps.

bible_refs.note: Israel pursuing the law did not attain it.

pass_a_gloss: As they were under-law and not having completed the very things according to law, they fell out of the through-law nature-salvation
pass_b_english: As they were under the law and, not having completed the very things according to the law, they fell from the salvation that is by nature through the law
source_text: Καθὼς ἔννομοι [ἐ]τύγχανον καὶ οὐ τὰ κατὰ ν[ό]μον αὐτὰ τελέσαντες, ἐξέ[π]εσαν τῆς διὰ νόμου φύσ[ε]ως σωτηρίας
